fields.Name: Skip ICF - Member Journey Timeline
fields.Description: Complete activity timeline for one named member (Finley Draper, ICF-101622) across joins, orders, courses, conferences, committees, certifications and competitions. Ported from "Complete Member Journey Timeline".

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me a complete activity timeline for member Finley Draper (member number ICF-101622): when they joined, their orders, course enrollments, conferences attended, committee service, certifications and competition entries. Present it as a chronological timeline chart. When I click on any activity, show me its details, and let me open the actual record. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a timeline visualization for Finley Draper
Timeline starts with the October 2017 join date and is chronologically ordered

Includes multiple activity types: orders, course enrollments (about 8), conference attendance, committee service (Membership & Outreach Committee member since 2021), certification (Food Safety & HACCP, in progress) and a 2018 competition entry
Clicking an activity shows its details
Links allow opening the underlying records
